item.title: TCN kindergarten registration begins March 2
item.description: LEWISBURG — Tri-County North Local Schools will be holding online kindergarten registration for the 2026-2027 school year Monday, March 2, through Friday, March 13. The post TCN kindergarten registration begins March 2 appeared first on The Register Herald.

item.title: Preble County ESC BAC earns Four-Star Business Advisory Council designation for 2026
item.description: EATON — The Preble County Educational Service Center has been recognized as one of Ohio’s top-performing Business Advisory Councils, earning a Four-Star designation as part of the state’s 2026 Business-Education Leader Awards for Excellent Business Advisory Councils. The post Preble County ESC BAC earns Four-Star Business Advisory Council designation for 2026 appeared first on The Register Herald.

item.title: Land Bank using Lead Safe Ohio funds to eliminate lead hazards
item.description: PREBLE COUNTY — The Preble County Land Reutilization Corporation (Preble County Land Bank) announced last week it is using funding from the Lead Safe Ohio Program to proactively remove and replace lead hazards in residential properties across the county. This effort is part of a broader, state-led initiative to protect children and families from the dangers of lead paint. item.title: Niehaus announces bid for PC Commissioner seat
item.description: EATON — In an announcement made earlier this week, Preble County ESC Career Connections Director Harold Niehaus announced he has decided to run for the Preble County Commissioner seat which begins Jan. 1, 2027. item.description: PIQUA — Edison State Community College honored 14 recent paramedic graduates with a celebration on Dec. 15, 2025, held at the Piqua Campus. Among them was Matthew Monroe of West Alexandria. The post Edison State honors paramedic graduates appeared first on The Register Herald.

item.title: Richardson retires as basketball announcer
item.description: BROOKVILLE — The golden tones of Brookville Basketball Public Address Announcer Mark Richardson came to an end February 14 after 48 years behind the microphone. Richardson officially retired from the position following the Blue Devils game against Middletown Madison. The post Richardson retires as basketball announcer appeared first on The Register Herald.

item.title: Board hires new elementary principal
item.description: BROOKVILLE — The Brookville Local Schools Board of Education approved a three-year contract (225 days) for Josh Pohl, who will become the district’s new elementary school principal. The post Board hires new elementary principal appeared first on The Register Herald.
